name: low-isotope-mass-table
description: Low-isotope mass + mass-excess table (Z ≤ 10) from the categorical derivation chain. Predicted columns are emitted ONLY for rows whose every input (m_p, m_n, B) traces to a fit-free derivation rooted in q₀. Rows lacking such a chain (m_n MeV scale; B(⁴He) and beyond) are emitted with row_derivation_status='derivation_pending' and predicted values set to null. CODATA / AME constants appear ONLY in *_ref fields for comparison.
